name: arboldelilith-app
description: Árbol de Lilith: the niche router + products jp-01 «La próxima luna» and jp-02 «Te leo» (El Taller Ep. 07, software evolutivo)

scripts.db:seed: node scripts/seed.mjs > .seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute arboldelilith --local --file=.seed.sql
scripts.db:reset: wrangler d1 execute arboldelilith --local --file=scripts/drop.sql && npm run db:init && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reset:remote: wrangler d1 execute arboldelilith --remote --file=scripts/drop.sql -y && wrangler d1 execute arboldelilith --remote --file=schema.sql -y && node scripts/seed.mjs > .seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute arboldelilith --remote --file=.seed.sql -y
